sec-01-c2.text: Microsoft (2017). Threats - Microsoft Threat Modeling Tool. Microsoft Learn.
sec-01-c2.quote: Microsoft uses the STRIDE model, which categorizes different types of threats and simplifies the overall security conversations.
sec-01-c2.claim: The STRIDE framework (Microsoft) lists categories of threats: Spoofing identity, Tampering with data, Repudiation, Information disclosure, Denial of service, Elevation of privilege.
